description: a ring of outer radius 10, bore 6 and height 8, both rims of its top face chamfered 2.5 in one call. The face is 4 wide, so the two chamfers together (5) use it up: their contact circles on the face fall at radii 7.5 and 8.5 and swap order. No solid has this shape; Open CASCADE returns a shape its own checker refuses. Arris refuses Reason::TooLarge naming both edges and the face, before any geometry is cut: the two rims' contacts cross on the one face (the retired tangency-faults plan)
